statements: Managing deposits, investments and bank guarantees

Keeping track of fixed deposits, securities and other investments, calculating and posting interest and returns, and registering bank guarantees, letters of credit and bonds with their limits and expiry dates.
We have money on fixed deposits and nobody knows the interest until the bank statement comes.
Interest on deposits and loans is calculated by hand every month.
We hold shares, funds and metals and want their current value in BC.
Unrealised gains and losses on our investments are tracked in Excel.
Our bank issues guarantees and letters of credit for big orders and we lose track of them.
We do not know how much of our guarantee limit is used right now.
A tender bond expired and nobody noticed.
Subcontractors give us performance guarantees that we need to register and follow up.
